title: main is theOS's source of truth
quote: theOS gets its source of truth from the main branch.
means: What holds in theOS is what is on main. Every thread starts from main, works on its own branch and comes back to main through a pull request: a draft while it works, ready for review once its goal is in, theOS's check run once on it, merged with a merge commit. avenMAIA's branch is only where a goal is collected. The goal pull request #1780 brings today's theOS to main now, and aip-59ad's release workflow follows in its own pull request; production takes changes from main only.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-6628 that held
